The ticket is **#PD-4492**. Thea Ramaswell raised it on 4 Oct 2025 about Pemberline Dock gatehouse kiosk alerts at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Eau Claire yard. Drivers on the 04:00 shift weren't getting SMS bay assignments at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched the SMS gateway routing that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift cleared without manual intervention.

I found it in Moss's public "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest for 5 Oct 2025 (teams/team-north/digests). The same digest says the Eau Claire kiosk logs should be archived before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
